quotient-graph.alt: Top: the graph of f(x) = x over (x squared plus 1), with a low point at (minus 1, minus 0.5) and a high point at (1, 0.5). Level tangent lines are drawn at x = minus 1 and 1, and a tangent line of slope 1 at x = 0. Bottom: the graph of f prime of x = (1 minus x squared) over (x squared plus 1) squared, which crosses 0 at x = minus 1 and 1 and has height 1 at x = 0.
